statement: The primary endpoint does not directly measure the concise Level 2 decision-retention behavior changed by commit 97d27dc.
why_primary: A null hidden-repair result would not distinguish an ineffective optimization from an insensitive benchmark, while a checklist-only score would not establish engineering outcomes.
blocked_upside: A dual-cohort design can test both the targeted mechanism and end-to-end repair value without conflating them.
